data.content:
Chico arrive into this match in wretched form. Jhon Gomez's side have lost their last three Primera A outings, conceding six goals across that run, and a 1-4 defeat to Atletico Nacional and a 2-0 reverse against Deportivo Pereira have done nothing for confidence at the club.

Bucaramanga, managed by Leonel Alvarez, come in with genuine momentum. Three wins from their last five Primera A matches, including a 3-1 victory over Junior FC, show a side that knows how to take points on the road. [...] Bucaramanga manager Leonel Alvarez also has no confirmed absences at this stage. Chico have scored just three goals and conceded seven across those five matches, a record that reflects their difficulties at both ends of the pitch.
